text: The authors restate the three-phase weak-to-strong pipeline of Burns et al. (2023): train a weak supervisor on ground truth, train a strong student on its labels, and train a strong ceiling model. They change the weak-supervisor phase: arguments from a debate between two instances of the strong pretrained model are generated and an ensemble of weak models is trained on samples augmented with these arguments.
title: Lang et al. add debate-augmented weak-model ensembles to Burns et al.'s weak-to-strong pipeline
